name: ICTK Co., Ltd.
summary: ICTK Co., Ltd., a South Korean firm, specializes in advanced vertical security technologies. They provide proprietary Security System-on-Chip (SoC) and software solutions, all adhering to international security benchmarks. Their leading innovation is a security chip founded on Physically Unclonable Function (PUF) technology, which is transforming semiconductor design by significantly boosting security. Utilizing their distinct VIA PUF technology, ICTK overcomes the inherent limitations of conventional PUF methods, delivering strong security without requiring error correction codes (ECC). Furthermore, ICTK's security offerings establish a Root of Trust (RoT), enabling reliable authentication and safeguarding data for Internet of Things (IoT) devices. Ultimately, through these pioneering solutions, they engineer and deliver state-of-the-art security chips, thereby streamlining intricate security requirements for their clientele.
